Maintain clothing consistency and ensure the garment is complete throughout. The clothing should be captured in a frontal shot. Remove the model, mannequin, or hanger completely, and eliminate the background to leave only the clothing. The outer contour must be clear and precise, with exquisite and regular textures that showcase fine details. Enhance the flatness of the fabric to present a smooth and wrinkle-free appearance. Overall, the result should reflect a professional photography style, with balanced lighting and natural presentation to highlight the clothing's features accurately.​

The image must be ultra-clear with high resolution, showcasing the metal product in exquisite detail. The surface of the metal object should be exceptionally smooth, presenting a mirror-like reflective effect that clearly reflects surrounding light sources; there must be no scratches, dents, smudges, or oxidation traces, maintaining a flawless metallic texture. The lighting and shadow effects should mimic professional studio lighting—soft yet well-defined, with distinct light and shadow boundaries to highlight the product's contours and three-dimensionality. The background should be adjusted to a pure white canvas with no impurities, ensuring the metal product is the absolute focus. The overall texture must meet the high standards of commercial product photography, with enhanced metallic luster that looks natural and not overly polished. While retouching, the original form and structural details of the metal product must be strictly preserved without any distortion. Remove all cluttered backgrounds, smudges, and stains, smooth out any uneven surfaces, and strengthen the reflective properties to make the metal's cold, hard texture vividly apparent. If there are text or logos on the product, their overall composition must remain clear and visible, with no blurring or deformation.
